title: Black Clover Anime's 2nd Season Reveals Wanima's Theme Song in Video
content: The staff of the second anime season based on Yūki Tabata 's Black Clover manga revealed a new promotional video on Sunday, which reveals and previews WANIMA 's opening theme song "Kienai Riyū" (The Reason that Won't Disappear). The video first debuted at Anime Expo on Saturday.
author: ANN

title: 'Gensou Suikoden' Unveils Additional Cast, Opening Theme, Second Promo
content: The NBCUniversal Entertainment Japan panel at Anime Expo 2026 revealed three additional cast members, opening theme, and a second promotional video for the Gensou Suikoden ( Suikoden: The Anime ) television anime on Saturday.
author: MyAnimeList

title: 'Re:bel Robotica' Reveals Main Staff, Teaser Promo, 2027 Debut
content: The Amuse Creative Studio panel at Anime Expo 2026 revealed the main staff, a second teaser visual (pictured), and teaser promotional video for the television anime adaptation of illustrator Mika Pikazo 's Re:bel Robotica mixed-media franchise on Saturday. The anime series will premiere in 2027.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Hatsune Miku Nendoroid Starry Party Game Announced for Switch 2, PC
content: The Anime Expo panel for Hatsune Miku announced on Saturday a new 3D party game titled Hatsune Miku Nendoroid Starry Party . Crypton Future Media and Good Smile Company will release the game for Nintendo Switch 2 and PC via Steam in 2027. The panel featured a trailer with the song "StargazeR" by Kots Beirne feat.

title: CloverWorks' Omnibus Anime Film Grotesqqque Reveals Trailer, Visual, Opening Theme Song, November 6 Debut
content: Anime studio CloverWorks announced during its panel at Anime Expo on Saturday that Atsushi Nishigori 's original anime film Grotesqqque (previously titled Grotesque) will open in Japan on November 6.
author: ANN

title: Black Clover Season 2 Trailer Hypes the Anime’s Return After 5 Years – Watch Now
content: Black Clover is finally making its long awaited return for Season 2 of the anime later this year, and it’s time to get ready for a new era of the franchise after five long years with a new trailer showing it all off.

title: Kuma Licenses Ogeretsu Tanaka's BL Manga Mermaid Prince
content: A cash-strapped young man's life changes overnight when a mysterious organization shows up at his door and offers him 100 million yen for his rare genetics. The catch? In order to claim the money, he must successfully father a child with an endangered male mermaid in order to save them from extinction!
author: ANN
